name: Loans and Advances for Construction of a House
benefit:
> ***Financial assistance for house construction for building workers:*** - Unskilled Labour: ₹1,00,000/-. - Simi-Skilled Labour: ₹1,50,000/-. - Skilled Labour: ₹2,00,000/-.
> ***Rate of Interest:*** - Simple interest rate of 5% per annum.
> ***Repayment:*** - 5-year repayment period with monthly installments.
_eligibility_text:
1. The construction worker should be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. 
1. The construction worker should have an active labor card.
1. The construction must execute a surety bond.
